section_summary.extract_value: This discussion summarizes a single study that evaluated a Romanian translation of the BAS-2, reporting a one-factor structure, internal consistency, test-retest reliability, and expected correlations with related constructs. The authors note a lack of full sex invariance (configural and intercept invariance not supported), caution about generalizability due to a student (college) sample, and recommend further validation work in broader Romanian-speaking populations.
